design.mulligan_rule: London; at most three mulligans, then keep four. The four initial orderings for each row are frozen; bottoming is a qualified pilot decision.
design.passive_fixture: Real engine two-player initialization against 60 Forest with deterministic land-play/pass policy. This fixture is not an admitted competitive opponent or a measured matchup.
design.matching: Shared per-card-copy ordering ranks couple each row across all four decks. The PLAY and DRAW members use the same row and are a cluster, not independent observations.
design.library_randomization_after_start: Hash-rank remaining original card-copy labels with UTF-8 domain IW_V2_R1_ORDERINGS_2026_09_25, row number, and shuffle ordinal; use stable original labels through zone changes. Exact algorithm and public-information invariance must pass deterministic fixtures before binding the runner.

metrics.three_tron_piece_access_turn: First own turn when at least one of each Tron land has legally entered the acting player's hand or battlefield. Seeing a card and putting it on the bottom does not count as access. Null through turn cap if absent, including no-Tron lists.
metrics.full_tron_turn: First own turn controlling at least one Mine, Power Plant and Tower, after real engine zone and type updates.
metrics.loop_ready_turn: First own turn with an executable resource-neutral Retriever/Altar cycle. Require accepted actions demonstrating sacrifice, another-Retriever return, cast and restored loop resources; available cards in an unordered inventory alone do not qualify.
metrics.deterministic_conversion_turn: First own turn with either real lethal resolution or a qualified deterministic loop certificate that forces lethal against this passive fixture without unknown future cards. A Foundry certificate must demonstrate charges, token creation and the next legal combat; tokens with summoning sickness are not immediate lethal. Record actual lethal and certified future conversion separately.
metrics.cards_seen_by_turn: Count distinct original card-copy labels legally revealed to or drawn by the acting player, including opening hand, scry and Rumble. Repeated observation of the same copy is not another distinct card.
metrics.dead_or_stranded_cards_by_turn: At each quiet precombat-main checkpoint record each hand copy with no currently legal cast or activation; distinguish insufficient total mana, unavailable colored payment, no legal target, timing restriction and voluntarily held executable card. These labels describe the checkpoint, not permanent card quality.
metrics.colored_mana_failure: An allocation has a failure if at any quiet precombat-main checkpoint a spell or relevant activated ability has legal targets and sufficient total generic-equivalent payment, but lacks a legal payment for its colored pips. Verify with the real mana planner; never assume a filter is free.
metrics.artifact_recursion_cycles_completed: Ledger count of artifact graveyard-to-hand movement followed by successful recast of that same copy. Separately count demonstrated full Retriever loop cycles.
metrics.caps: Report turn cap, action cap, draw, exception, rejected action and unresolved telemetry separately. Do not manufacture a winner. A valid cap without a demonstrated metric event is a metric failure, not missing data.

decision_rule.eligibility: Gain at least 8/128 net allocations in loop-ready by T8 OR deterministic conversion by T8, with at most 4/128 additional colored-mana failures and at most 4/128 additional allocations having a total-mana-stranded card at the T4 checkpoint. Counts are prospective screening margins, not statistical significance thresholds.
decision_rule.uncertainty: Report all four-deck numerators, paired discordant counts and cluster-level paired differences. Provide mean difference plus 95% normal-approximation interval using 64 row-cluster means; explicitly qualify approximation and deterministic-corpus scope. No unpaired pooling of 128 PLAY/DRAW allocations.
decision_rule.zero_eligible: Close this bounded redesign attempt with no promoted candidate; do not introduce a fourth family.
decision_rule.survivors: Advance at most two to prospectively specified deterministic disruption/recovery and then fresh controlled matchups only after their exact capability, policy, execution and seed authority is frozen. R1 qualification is not deck promotion.
decision_rule.invalid_evidence: Quarantine affected attempt and stop exposure. Do not rerun any allocation or select replacements under this protocol; a defect-specific prospective amendment with recorded authority is required. An implementation blocker is not a candidate failure.

execution_gates: Committed exact R0 deck/count/legality/corpus/protocol freeze validates.
Every candidate and comparator card resolves in the live compiled catalog and all used mechanics execute faithfully.

A single qualified structural pilot exposes only acting-player observations and covers all four exact lists, including non-Tron land selection, scry/mill/recursion, filters, sacrifice draws and loop conversion. No hand/future-order leakage.
Exact real-engine initialization, London mulligans, schedules, shuffle coupling and all telemetry definitions pass deterministic non-corpus fixtures.

Effective rules archive and digest, engine commit/tree, compiled card snapshot, pilot, runner, telemetry and artifact contract are frozen in a runtime-binding receipt. No null or placeholder identity is accepted.
A durable exclusive claim and append-only attempt record exist before first initialization. Cross-chat and workflow duplicate-claim checks pass against live branch HEAD.
The journal and artifact contract preserve all 512 allocations, accepted action/event streams, terminal or capped status, replay digests and decisions without selective omission.
A separately recorded R1 execution authorization references the exact runtime bindings and expected branch HEAD. R0 construction authority alone cannot initialize this corpus.
